keyConcerns: Exam fee compensation insufficient without pay restoration

referendumProjection.keyFactor: Senior grades reject partial offer while juniors tempted by 4% increase

llmNotes: Unity dropped from 80% to 72% due to grade-splitting nature of DHSC offer. FY1/FY2 see tangible benefits (4% + housing support), but ST6-ST8/LED feel betrayed and view offer as divide-and-rule tactic. Referendum would fail with only 25% yes vote if held now. Key risk: if RDC recommends acceptance despite low projected support, could cause internal fracture in BMA. Base demands concrete timeline for all 2000 places and full pay restoration roadmap before considering acceptance.
